description: I know what I know and that’s enough. #selflove #selfcare #selflovejourney
transcript: I know what I know, and on a bigger scope, it's not much, but it's enough. And that keeps me existing in the present moment. I am such a small piece of this big puzzle that my ability to explore all the offerings matters. Tiny little steps create a larger picture that's bigger than me. I know what I know and it's enough.
